question: How was the bliss-named self as object of knowledge expounded sixteenfold?
premises: A self named bliss is identified.
It is considered in the aspect of the knowable object.
This aspect is expounded in sixteen divisions.
inference: The bliss-named self, as the knowable, is articulated in sixteen forms.
plain_english: The bliss-named self, as the object of knowledge, was expounded in a sixteenfold way.
